svg.text: Boeing 707-124 demonstration: centrograms with 8,000 lb center payload
Case I CG envelope and tank capacities/arms: FAA TCDS 4A21 Rev. 8 (1973). Aircraft basic data, passenger area, center payload, and fuel sequence are illustrative.
Longitudinal CG station (inches aft of datum)
Blue groups are bounded in weight–moment space and certified against every fuel segment up to the robust cap. Orange is the directly evaluated all-heavy limiting group.
The green region is a public certification envelope, but this SVG is a mathematical demonstration only — never use it for aircraft loading or flight planning.
